issues.description: Inconsistent identifier for the result storage variable: the problem statement requires a variable named `score_counter` (problem_statement.md:22), the solution defines a different variable `score_cnt` (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm:4), and the template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm:2-3) does not declare any `score_*` variable. This breaks the direct mapping between the exercise instruction and the provided code, which may confuse students about which identifier to create/use and can cause automated checks or grading scripts that expect `score_counter` to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the variable name consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: use `score_counter`. Edit template_repository/helloWorld.asm to add the declaration in the .data section (e.g. add `score_counter dd 0` next to the existing `hello db ...`), and rename `score_cnt` to `score_counter` in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm (line 4). If there are any references to the variable elsewhere (tests or grader), update them to the chosen name. Alternatively, if `score_cnt` is preferred, update the problem statement to require `score_cnt` instead — but ensure all three artifacts match.
